title: The Peptide Journey

overview0: A production-ready peptide commerce platform built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and MongoDB. Includes guest checkout, atomic inventory reservations, provider-agnostic payments with verified webhooks, and an admin suite ΓÇö all without a separate backend server.

title: MK Heating
description: A conversion-focused heating and plumbing website for an East London business, featuring local SEO pages, service information, booking CTAs, Google reviews, and a responsive branded interface.
overview0: MK Heating is a premium website redesign for an East London heating and plumbing company. The project replaces a cluttered, spam-contaminated legacy site with a clean, conversion-focused experience ΓÇö built for local SEO, fast mobile booking, and a clear brand presence.

title: AJ Cleaning London

title: GroundRoots Initiative

overview0: GroundRoots Initiative (groundroots.org) is the public website and operations stack for a community CIC in Plaistow, East London. It promotes free youth sport and family programmes, takes donations/enquiries, sells merchandise via Stripe, and includes an internal Academy Tracker for coaches (childrenΓÇÖs session data, offline-first sync, EU photo storage).

title: EcoScrap

overview0: HobbyHub is a community-driven web app where people can discover, join, or create local hobby-based groups (e.g. Fishing, Photography, Running) and connect with like-minded individuals.
